mood.label: Neighborly Make-Believe
mood.summary: A neighborhood library hums with anticipation as everyday objects come back carrying wildly different adventures.

storyteller.quirk: Give each returned object a tiny pause before revealing where it has been.

kid_older.quirk: Start an adventure and invite a younger listener to add a detail.

kid_younger.quirk: Act out a borrower's idea, like stirring a soup as big as a pond.

art.style_prompt_prefix: Original Giggle & Snooze pencil-and-brush illustration: distinctive asymmetric silhouettes, angular faces and varied proportions, warm expressive characters. Define each character by unique face geometry, hair silhouette, wardrobe and a signature detail; preserve these across pages. Confident imperfect graphite and coloured pencil with visible searching strokes, matte gouache and broken dry-brush edges on fresh light paper. Vibrant rich teal, coral, leaf green, copper, lilac, gold and plum adapted to the story; preserve natural skin tones. Avoid interchangeable round bean-shaped characters.
art.line: Broken pencil contours, visible overshoots, sparse construction strokes and light hatching; irregular brush edges, never uniform vector outlines.
art.lighting: Rich local colour, restrained matte painted shadows and fresh paper highlights; no dusty grey veil, neon or glossy gradients.
art.composition: One clear action, readable faces and hands, distinctive silhouettes and breathing room. Asymmetric scenery: crooked roofs, mismatched windows and bent trunks where appropriate to the setting.
avoid: aged paper, sepia washes and vintage styling
individual fur strands and intricate clothing detail
existing franchise characters or imitation of an artist
texture that obscures faces, gestures or story-relevant props

qa.format_label: At the Checkout and Return Counter
qa.intro_hook: Welcome to Bea’s library! If you checked out this tiny whisk, what adventure would you take it on?
qa.outro_hook: Pick an everyday thing to lend someone. What story would you love to hear when they bring it back?

kid_notes.kid_older: Start an adventure, then invite another listener to add a detail.
kid_notes.kid_younger: Offer two ideas if needed and leave room for a word, gesture, or sentence.

sound.music_direction: Soft pizzicato and felt piano. Give returns a short answering phrase, use a soft bell for arrivals, and lower the music during questions.

rationale: Use the same look on covers and pages. Bea has a wedge-shaped face, side braid, teal apron and coral ear pencil. A tall, long-faced neighbor has a flat top and green coat with a gold cuff patch. A short, diamond-faced neighbor has an off-center puff, coral vest and plum scarf. In the crooked corner shop, the cover shows Bea lending the star button, inviting readers to imagine where it goes.
